paper_metadata.title: Brief Papers_______________________________________________________________________________
paper_metadata.abstract: Area-efficient 4 charge pumps based on the cross-coupled structure that uses the –2 outputs alternately to reduce the number of power devices and capacitors are presented. Compared with conventional designs, our best design can save two power transistors, one capacitor, and two level shift circuits. An integrated 4 charge pump is then designed to deliver 100 A at 9 V using a 0.8m AMS high-voltage CMOS process. The topology can be extended to 2 charge pumps, and a 6 charge pump is also fabricated and tested to demonstrate the validity of the extension.
